goal: Is ke baad aap array mein sab se chhoti aur sab se bari value aur unki positions nikaal sakte hain, samjha sakte hain ke hum a[0] se shuru kyun karte hain, aur second largest ka idea samajh sakte hain.
warmup: Paanch cricketers apni innings khatam karte hain. Scorer ko top scorer chahiye. Woh pehle player ka score dekhta hai aur kehta hai 'ab tak sab se acha'. Phir woh agle har player ko check karta hai: agar score zyada hai to woh player naya best ban jata hai. Aakhir mein jo bhi 'ab tak sab se acha' hota hai wohi top scorer hai. Use kisi ko do dafa dekhne ki zaroorat nahi parti. Array mein maximum dhoondhna bilkul yehi hai, aur minimum wahi kahani hai bas 'zyada' ki jagah 'kam'.
definition: Maximum sab se bari value hoti hai aur minimum sab se chhoti value hoti hai. Hum inhein ek loop aur ek variable se nikaalte hain jo ab tak dekhi gayi sab se achhi value yaad rakhta hai. Hum is variable ko pehle element a[0] se shuru karte hain aur phir baaki har element se compare karte hain. Agar koi naya element isay haraye to hum isay badal dete hain. Aksar hum sab se achhi value ki position (index) bhi yaad rakhte hain.
howItWorks: Minmax visual dekhein. Sab se pehle maxVal ko a[0] par set kiya jata hai, kyun ke kuch dekhne se pehle pehla element hi akela candidate hota hai. Phir loop i = 1 se shuru hota hai (a[0] ko apne aap se compare karne ki zaroorat nahi). Har step par: agar a[i] > maxVal ho to maxVal = a[i] aur maxPos = i. Minimum ke liye test a[i] < minVal hota hai. Loop ke baad maxVal mein sab se bari value aur maxPos mein uska index hota hai. Ahem baat: maxVal ko kabhi 0 se shuru na karein. Agar saari values negative hon (maslan -8, -3, -15) to 0 un sab ko hara dega aur aap 0 report karenge, jo array mein hai hi nahi. a[0] se shuru karna hamesha durust hai. Second largest ka idea: pehle maximum ki position dhoondein, phir doosra loop chalayein jo baaki positions mein se sab se bari value dhoondhta hai.
